'''Chokoo Thool''' was the leader of a group of [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Thief/Legends|thieves]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. [[Gender/Legends|He]] wore the uniform of [[Rodia Consolidated Refineries]], and may have worked there at one point.
